_comment: Buildings inside settlements (DESIGN §3.3). Every building needs 'hands' to run; staffing is linear (half staff = half effect). 'mandatory' buildings exist from founding and cannot be demolished. Phase 1 session 1 defines only the two mandatory families (hall, granary); the starter list from DESIGN §3.3 will be added with effects in a later session. Names of the village hall and the metropolis hall are PLACEHOLDERS (DESIGN §5). Hands are draft, at MODEL SCALE ×3 (see data/economy.json modelScale): hall 30/150/300/600, granary 90/180/360/720.
